user_sees: The list opens in a few seconds and scrolls; every count is the true total
must_not: A count that stops at a page size, missing rows of One-time sign-in code for a gym person, or a screen that freezes

steps.action: Make a sign-in code for yourself in Staff & sign-in
user_sees: A 6-digit code shown once
must_not: The same code shown again later

steps.action: On the phone type the mobile and the code
user_sees: The gym opens on the phone
must_not: The laptop signed out
